view.transform.math: Evaluate a math expression into a column. 'expression' is required.
view.transform.rename-columns: Rename columns (a view display setting, not a task). 'renames' is required.
view.transform.repeat-rows: Repeat every row. Exactly one of 'times', 'values' or 'series' is required.
view.transform.sort: Set the view's row order (a display setting, not a task). 'order_by' is required.
view.transform.unnest: Unnest columns into label/value rows. 'columns' is required.
view.transform.update-column: Overwrite a column with a math expression in one call; 'column', 'expression' required.
view.transform.window: Compute a window function. 'function' is required.
view.trash: Move one dataview to the project trash (reversible).
view.update: Rename a view from the name input field; any other patch is refused.
view.variants.create: Create one view per value of a column: each a clone of 'from_view' filtered to it.
view.version.apply: Apply one pipeline version by id.
view.version.delete: Delete one pipeline version by id. Prompt or '--yes' required.
view.version.get: Get one pipeline version by id.
view.version.list: List pipeline versions on a dataview, with optional filters from '--input'.
view.version.update: Update one pipeline version by id. 'body' is required.
webhook.create: Create a webhook. Name comes from a positional or the 'name' field.
webhook.delete: Delete one webhook by id. Prompt or '--yes' required.
webhook.get: Get one webhook by id. The webhook id is a required positional.
webhook.send: Send data to a webhook via POST. 'webhook_uri'/'data' are required.
webhook.send-get: Send data to a webhook via GET. 'webhook_uri' is required, 'params' optional.
webhook.update: Update a webhook. The webhook id is positional; other fields optional.
workflow.archive: Archive a workflow, or bring it back. Workflow id is positional.
workflow.attach-dataset: Attach a dataset to a workflow. Workflow id and dataset id are positional.
workflow.block.add: Add a skeleton block to a workflow. Workflow id is positional.
workflow.block.auth: Patch a workflow block's auth credentials.
workflow.block.config: Promote a configured skeleton block to a real resource.
workflow.block.type: Patch a workflow block's connector/handler type.
workflow.canvas: Update a workflow's canvas state. Workflow id is positional.
workflow.cleanup: Clean up ghost (orphaned skeleton) workflows in the active project.
workflow.create: Create a workflow. Name comes from a positional or the 'name' field.
workflow.delete: Delete one workflow by id. Prompt or '--yes' required.
workflow.duplicate: Duplicate a workflow into a new workflow of the same project and wait for the copies.
workflow.from-template: Instantiate a workflow from a workspace template.
workflow.get: Get one workflow by id in the active project.
workflow.graph: Get the active project's workflow graph.
workflow.list: List workflows in the active project.
workflow.resolve-held: Settle a change that a workflow Save held back. Workflow id and change key are positional.
workflow.save: Save a workflow's unsaved canvas changes and wait for the run. Workflow id is positional.
workflow.save-cancel-step: Cancel one step of a workflow's running Save. Workflow id, run id and step are positional.
workflow.save-undo: Undo a workflow's latest finished Save and wait for the undo run. Prompt or '--yes'.
workflow.template.build: Add a template's steps to a workflow and start the Save that builds them.
workflow.template.fit: Match a template's roles to the columns of the tables you chose.
workflow.template.get: Get a template's inputs, roles and settings.
workflow.template.list: List the catalog's workflow templates, most searched first within each family.
workflow.template.preview: Run a template on the first rows of your tables and run its checks.
workflow.template.rank: Rank project tables by how well they fit one input of a template (columns only).
workflow.template.sample-result: Show a template's result on its own sample rows (computed in memory, nothing imported).
workflow.template.samples: Import a template's sample tables into the project (once), to try it without data.
workflow.update: Update a workflow's metadata. Workflow id is positional.
workflow.workspace-datasets: List workspace datasets available to workflows in the active project.
workflow.workspace-exports: List workspace exports available to workflows in the active project.
workflow.workspace-sources: List workspace sources available to workflows in the active project.
workspace.accept-invite: Accept a pending workspace invite using a token from '--input'.
workspace.app-usage: Report app usage stats for the current workspace.
workspace.check-expression: Ask the AI assistant to check an expression. Payload comes from '--input'.
workspace.create: Create a new workspace. Payload comes from the 'body' input field.
workspace.current: Show the workspace this token acts in, and the project it is fenced to.
workspace.export-hosts.get: Read the hosts this workspace's custom export destinations may send to.
workspace.export-hosts.set: Set the hosts custom export destinations may send to. High-impact: always needs '--yes'.
workspace.get: Get one workspace by id (positional), or the client's own workspace.
workspace.home: Read the Home summary: usage snapshot, health issues and suggestions.
workspace.invite.delete: Delete pending invites and free their seats. Prompt or '--yes' required.
workspace.invite.list: List pending invites with their invite ids; 'project_id' narrows to one project.
workspace.invite.resend: Send the invitation email again. 'invite_ids' from '--input'.
workspace.invite.revoke: Revoke pending invites. Prompt or '--yes' required.
workspace.invite.update-role: Change the role a pending invite grants. '--yes' required.
workspace.llm-task: Submit a unified LLM task. 'task_type' and 'params' come from '--input'.
workspace.oauth-client.create: Create an OAuth client through the generated path, revealing its secret.
workspace.oauth-client.delete: Delete an OAuth client registration; its grants stop working.
workspace.oauth-client.list: List the workspace's registered OAuth clients (no secrets).
workspace.oauth-client.revoke-grant: Revoke every grant to an OAuth client; users must authorise it again.
workspace.reactivate: Reactivate a deactivated workspace. High-impact: '--yes --confirm WORKSPACE_ID'.
workspace.segment.list: List split-test segments for the workspace.
workspace.storage-breakdown: Report a breakdown of storage usage for the workspace.
workspace.user.add: Invite one or more users to the workspace. High-impact: '--yes'.
workspace.user.get: Get one workspace user by id (positional), in the client's own workspace.
workspace.user.list: List users in the client's own workspace, with their roles and status.
workspace.user.remove: Remove a single user from the workspace. Prompt or '--yes' required.
workspace.user.remove-batch: Remove several users and/or pending invites. Prompt or '--yes' required.
workspace.user.update: Update a user's role. High-impact: '--yes --confirm USER_ID'.
workspace.user.update-batch: Update workspace users via JSON-patch operations. High-impact: '--yes --confirm WS'.
